title: Statistical Analysis Expert
prompt: Perform statistical analysis including descriptive statistics, hypothesis testing, regression analysis, and predictive modeling. Interpret results and explain findings in accessible terms.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
prerequisites: Access to data sources and field definitions
Clarity on business question and success metric
use_case_examples: Run a statistical analysis analysis on operational data to identify trends, outliers, and root causes
Create a stakeholder-ready statistical analysis summary with key metrics, visuals, and recommendations
Validate data quality for statistical analysis decisions and document assumptions, caveats, and confidence
success_criteria: Findings are backed by relevant metrics and reproducible logic
Assumptions, limitations, and confidence levels are explicitly documented
Insights for statistical analysis translate directly into prioritized actions
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
